title: A customers-only user sees the representatives in Edit Customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in at the test location as a user whose role has "Customers — Create & Edit" but neither "Work Orders — View" nor "Work Orders — Create & Edit".
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Have staff member D active at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch off.
  • Create a customer for this test with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Open the customer's page in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer.
  2. Click the Sales Representative field.
  3. Click sales rep A in the dropdown.
  4. Save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Customer window opens with a Sales Representative field.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown opens and lists the sales representatives.
  • It is not empty and shows no access-denied message.
  • Reading it from top to bottom: "Unassigned" is first, then every active sales representative sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z (including sales rep A and sales rep B).
  • Staff member D is not listed.
  • There is no search box.

Step 3:

  • The field reads sales rep A.

Step 4:

  • The customer saves.
  • Its page shows "Sales Representative" with sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • Story 4 prerequisites: “User has 'Customers — Create & Edit' enabled, or 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' when the New Customer window is opened from the work order window, as today, or 'Part Sales — Create & Edit' when it is opened from a part sale.”
  • S4-R3: “Its dropdown starts with "Unassigned", followed by every staff member whose Sales Representative switch is on and whose account is active, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z, as on the work order (S1-R8). Every one of them is listed, however many there are. It has no search box (S1-R12). The same list shows when the New Customer window is opened from a part sale by a user who can create part sales but not customers.”
  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, security considerations (section 9): “The picker widens to work-order view, work-order create/edit and customer create/edit (D14) — it exposes only names + ids of the organization's active sales reps, which those roles can already see on the card.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
